headline.purpose: Page titles and primary section headings.

title.purpose: Card group headers and modal titles.

body.purpose: Default clinical copy, form inputs, and table rows.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action trigger across booking, member creation, and clinical saves.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; background: #0037c1; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(0, 55, 193, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 55, 193, 0.25); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary contextual action such as Lịch sử khám or cancel triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #ffffff; color: #0a1e30; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10, 30, 48, 0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #eef2ff; color: #0037c1; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Standard form field with high-clarity cobalt focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-default { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #ffffff; color: #0a1e30; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10, 30, 48, 0.04); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-default:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0037c1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 55, 193, 0.2); }

components.name: Clinical Card
components.description: Clean white clinical surface atop dashboard canvas with hairline border.
components.html:
Hồ sơ cá nhân
Thông tin sức khỏe và sinh hiệu theo dõi liên tục.
components.css: .ds-card-default { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 20px 24px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #ffffff; color: #0a1e30; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(32, 40, 61, 0.05); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #0a1e30; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: #444654; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill badge for relationship roles, clinical states, and alerts.
components.css: .ds-badge-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #c7d2fe; background: rgba(238, 242, 255, 0.8); color: #0037c1; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Header Breadcrumb
components.description: Hierarchical topbar breadcrumb where parent links stay muted slate and only the current page uses active primary cobalt.
components.html: Hộ gia đình›Quản lý Thành viên›Phạm Ngọc Thọ
components.css: .ds-breadcrumb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; } .ds-breadcrumb-link { color: #64748b; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-breadcrumb-link:hover { color: #0037c1; } .ds-breadcrumb-sep { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-breadcrumb-page { color: #0037c1; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Modern Clinical Minimalist system rooted in structured clarity, deliberate whitespace, and calibrated Medical Cobalt anchors (#0037c1) paired with warm amber urgency markers and clinical green reassurance.
keyCharacteristics: Be Vietnam Pro across all surfaces with tabular numerals for vitals and timestamps
Pure white clinical cards (#ffffff) atop #f5f6f8 dashboard canvas with crisp #e2e8f0 hairline borders
Accessible WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and minimum 44x44px mobile touch targets

rules.name: Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Activate tabular-nums for vitals, appointment timestamps, and medical dosage metrics.

rules.name: Weight Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Heaviest permitted weight is 700 (font-bold); avoid font-black, font-extrabold, and monospace fonts.

dos: Do keep parent breadcrumb segments muted slate (#64748b) and highlight only the active current page in primary cobalt (#0037c1).
Do use hairline #e2e8f0 borders with subtle diffused shadows on clinical cards.
donts: Don't nest cards unnecessarily or invent mock medical metrics when API data is absent.
Don't use font-mono or font weights above 700.
